markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (95%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and neighbors agree, but the second model disagrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 95%, Normal 3%, InSitu 2% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.98 / 88th percentile | Reliable; OOD fairly high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Benign | Mostly supportive [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Score below typical; concept model leans away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Score above typical; associated with non-invasive tissue [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Score below typical; small lowering term · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Score typical; fails spot check, not a reason [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) may have shifted features; the MUSK model picked a different top class.
- Small test set (132): conformal coverage CI 81–98%, so the single-class set may under-cover.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 5, 10**: confirm glandular architecture is benign, with no infiltrative pattern.
2. **Region 1**: look for stromal infiltration; strongest location for that concept.
3. **Region 6**: check whether atypical cells are duct-confined; that concept is only Weak (12/20).
